# Amazon.de
> Amazon.de is Amazon’s German marketplace for shopping, digital services, customer support, and seller resources.

This site serves German-speaking customers with retail browsing, account management, orders, returns, Prime benefits, gift cards, and device-related help. It also links to Amazon services for sellers, developers, and publishing.

## Shopping & Deals
- [Amazon.de Startseite](https://www.amazon.de/): Main storefront for browsing products, deals, and personalized recommendations.
- [Angebote](https://www.amazon.de/gp/goldbox): Central deals page for limited-time offers and discounts.
- [Bestseller](https://www.amazon.de/gp/bestsellers): Lists top-selling products across major categories.
- [Neuerscheinungen](https://www.amazon.de/gp/new-releases): Shows newly released and trending products by category.
- [Angebote des Tages](https://www.amazon.de/deals): Highlights current daily deals and promotional campaigns.
- [Geschenkgutscheine](https://www.amazon.de/gift-cards): Browse and purchase Amazon gift cards in multiple formats.

## Customer Service
- [Kundenservice](https://www.amazon.de/gp/help/customer/display.html): Main help hub for orders, payments, returns, and account issues.
- [Hilfe](https://www.amazon.de/hz/contact-us): Contact and support entry point for customer service requests.
- [Versandinformationen](https://www.amazon.de/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201910100): Explains shipping options, delivery times, and related policies.
- [Rücksendungen und Erstattungen](https://www.amazon.de/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201819200): Covers return eligibility, refund timing, and return methods.
- [Zahlungsarten](https://www.amazon.de/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201895010): Describes accepted payment methods and billing details.
- [Produktsicherheit und Rückrufe](https://www.amazon.de/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=G201889520): Information about product safety notices and recalls.

## Orders, Returns & Account
- [Mein Konto](https://www.amazon.de/gp/css/homepage.html): Manage profile, addresses, payments, and account preferences.
- [Meine Bestellungen](https://www.amazon.de/gp/css/order-history): View order history, invoices, tracking, and order actions.
- [Warenrückgabe oder Artikel ersetzen](https://www.amazon.de/returns): Start a return, replacement, or refund request.
- [Meine Wunschlisten](https://www.amazon.de/hz/wishlist/ls): Access and manage personal wish lists and gift lists.
- [Adressbuch](https://www.amazon.de/a/addresses): Manage shipping addresses associated with the account.
- [Zahlungsoptionen](https://www.amazon.de/cpe/yourpayments/wallet): Review and update saved payment methods and wallet settings.

## Prime & Membership
- [Amazon Prime](https://www.amazon.de/amazonprime): Overview of Prime shipping, streaming, and membership benefits.
- [Prime Video](https://www.amazon.de/gp/video/storefront): Streaming hub for included and rentable video content.
- [Prime Gaming](https://gaming.amazon.com/): Gaming benefits, free content, and member rewards.
- [Prime Reading](https://www.amazon.de/kindle-dbs/fd/prime-pr): Access rotating ebooks and magazines included with Prime.
- [Amazon Music Prime](https://www.amazon.de/music/prime): Music streaming benefits available with Prime membership.

## Digital Content & Devices
- [Kindle eBooks](https://www.amazon.de/kindle-dbs/storefront): Kindle ebook storefront and reading ecosystem entry point.
- [Kindle Unlimited](https://www.amazon.de/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku): Subscription offering access to a large ebook catalog.
- [Amazon Music](https://music.amazon.de/): Music streaming service for playlists, albums, and podcasts.
- [Amazon Photos](https://www.amazon.de/b?node=10838178031): Information about Amazon Photos storage and features.
- [Alexa & Echo](https://www.amazon.de/b?node=16262208031): Explore Alexa-enabled devices and smart home products.
- [Fire TV](https://www.amazon.de/firetv): Fire TV devices, streaming features, and related content.

## Seller & Marketplace Services
- [Verkaufen bei Amazon](https://sell.amazon.de/): Seller portal for marketplace onboarding, tools, and programs.
- [Seller Central](https://sellercentral.amazon.de/): Operational dashboard for managing listings, orders, and performance.
- [Versand durch Amazon (FBA)](https://sell.amazon.de/programme/versand-durch-amazon): Fulfillment service information for storage, shipping, and returns.
- [Amazon Advertising](https://advertising.amazon.com/de-de): Advertising platform for sponsored products and brand campaigns.
- [Amazon Brand Registry](https://brandservices.amazon.de/): Brand protection and intellectual property tools for registered brands.
- [Handmade bei Amazon](https://sell.amazon.de/programme/handmade): Program for artisans selling handcrafted products on Amazon.

## Publishing & Creative Platforms
- [Kindle Direct Publishing](https://kdp.amazon.com/de_DE/): Self-publishing platform for ebooks and print books.
- [Amazon Ads Blog Deutschland](https://advertising.amazon.com/de-de/library/news): Articles and updates about Amazon advertising products.
- [Amazon Merch on Demand](https://merch.amazon.com/): Print-on-demand platform for apparel and branded merchandise.
- [Amazon Music for Artists](https://artists.amazonmusic.com/): Tools for artists to manage profiles and audience insights.
- [Amazon Publishing](https://amazonpublishing.amazon.com/): Information about Amazon’s publishing imprints and submissions.

## Developers & APIs
- [Amazon Developer](https://developer.amazon.com/): Developer hub for Alexa, Appstore, and Amazon device integrations.
- [Alexa Skills Kit](https://developer.amazon.com/alexa): Documentation and tools for building Alexa skills.
- [Selling Partner API](https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/): API documentation for sellers, vendors, and marketplace integrations.
- [Appstore Developer Console](https://developer.amazon.com/apps-and-games): Resources for publishing Android apps on Amazon devices.
- [Login with Amazon](https://developer.amazon.com/login-with-amazon): Identity and OAuth integration for Amazon sign-in.
- [Amazon Pay für Händler](https://pay.amazon.de/business/merchant): Merchant information for integrating Amazon Pay checkout.

## Policies & Legal
- [Datenschutzerklärung](https://www.amazon.de/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GX7NJQ4ZB8MHFRNJ): Explains how Amazon.de collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [Nutzungsbedingungen](https://www.amazon.de/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GLSBYFE9MGKKQXXM): Terms governing use of Amazon.de services and content.
- [Impressum](https://www.amazon.de/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201909000): Legal company information and required disclosures.
- [Cookies-Hinweis](https://www.amazon.de/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201909010): Information about cookies and related user choices.
- [Bedingungen für Prime](https://www.amazon.de/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GWMXCP6AN3QDTLA9): Membership terms and conditions for Amazon Prime in Germany.
- [Verkaufsbedingungen](https://www.amazon.de/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201909000): Legal and transactional terms for purchases on Amazon.de.
